messages.author: 4e956cc50ac3e075
messages.subject: new version of AICcmodavg
parts:
Hi,

Just a heads up that AICcmodavg now supports newer models fit with unmarked functions 'occuMS', 'OccuTTD'
'multmixOpen', 'distsampOpen', and 'occuMulti', including model-averaged predictions with modavgPred( ) for these model types. I added a new function detTime( ) to summarize time-to-detection data. I also corrected a bug in the GOF for Royle-Nichols model (thanks to Ken Kellner).

The new version of AICcmodavg is on CRAN now.

Best,

Marc
